prompt: Assess this claim: Asian people have been enslaved at some point in history.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
The claim is **true**. People from many Asian populations have been enslaved at various points in history.

Examples include slavery in ancient China, the enslavement of Koreans during Japan’s invasions of Korea in the 1590s, and the enslavement of people from South and Southeast Asia within Indian Ocean trading networks.

“Asian” covers many distinct peoples and societies, so the claim should not imply a single shared historical experience.
